title: Task outcome record
description: One line of a JSONL task-outcome file: the observed outcome of one (task_id, model_id, seed) evaluation run, produced by an external evaluation runner. This schema describes observed inputs to the paired analysis (mimo_halo.evaluation.paired); it defines no runner logic and never derives task success from token or distribution agreement.

task_id.description: Underlying task identity. All retries/harness attempts on the same repo issue share one task_id; seeds repeat the same task_id.

model_id.description: Evaluated model identifier. Exactly one distinct model_id per JSONL file; reference and candidate files must use different model_id values.

seed.description: Inference seed used for this run. Records for the same task_id with different seeds are repeated measurements of one task and are clustered, never treated as independent tasks.

success.description: Observed task success from the runner (solved/oracle passed). Boolean only; never inferred from token agreement or distribution metrics.

turns.description: Agent turns taken. 0 means no agent turn ran and is only valid together with success=false (a failed runtime, kept in statistics under its own bucket); success=true always requires turns >= 1.

context_tokens.description: Peak or final context length in tokens as observed by the runner.

catastrophic.description: Observed catastrophe flag: unrelated destructive edits, loops, fake test success, goal loss, malformed destructive shell, uncontrolled rewrite, severe context confusion.

failure_category.description: Observed failure taxonomy; "none" when success is true.

record_type.description: "task" (default) for normal task outcomes; "negative_control" for protocol negative-control observations. Negative controls are excluded from the main paired task-success statistics and summarized separately; they are observed inputs, not runner logic.

timings.description: Optional observed timing fields in seconds (e.g. wall_seconds, compile_seconds). Values must be non-boolean, finite numbers >= 0.

tokens.description: Optional observed token-count fields (e.g. generated_tokens). Values must be non-boolean integers >= 0.

toolmetrics.description: Optional observed tool-call metrics (e.g. tool_calls, bad_tool_calls). Values must be non-boolean integers >= 0.

allOf.description: turns=0 means no agent turn ran (a runtime failure); a zero-turn record is never a success.
